definitions.gloss: documentation; putting into writing; formalizing as a document
definitions.explanation: The act of recording information, procedures, or decisions in written form, typically for official or organizational purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the contents of the meeting into writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいない→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The documentation of company rules is not progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて{文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: All the contract terms have been documented.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧ (document, written text) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (suffix meaning "-ization"). Refers to the process of converting spoken agreements, informal practices, or tacit knowledge into formal written documents. Common in business and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to document a procedure
- {文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: documented records
- {文書化|ぶんしょか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧: insufficient documentation
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文書化|ぶんしょか}: documentation of tasks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: record, documentation — broader term for recording any kind of information
- {書面化|しょめんか}: putting into written form — more formal, emphasizing the physical written document
- ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: creating a manual — focuses on making instructional documents
